extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: NTRanch's unified haptics MCP server: Lovense devices (the Standard API local Game Mode route, plus the opt-in Server API cloud route) Buttplug devices (an embedded in-process server), and TCode multi-axis devices (SR6/OSR2/SSR1 over serial or UDP, opt-in) behind one gated tool surface of sixteen tools, including a program engine for frozen declarative patterns, funscript packs, automations, and sessions. Every output passes a single pure decide() gate: master off by default, the intensity ceiling clamped in code, bounded durations only, a 5-second heartbeat watchdog, no resume on reconnect, and a synchronous panic stop that zeroes every device on every provider. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Ache does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Ache

skills.description: Report server state, transport, arming, ceiling, watchdog, and per-provider accounts (lovense_status); list the Lovense provider's toys (lovense_toys); and discover devices across every provider in the unified model - lovense:<toy id>, buttplug:<index>, serverapi:<toy id>, tcode:0 - with capabilities reported as data (ache_devices, ache_device).
skills.name: Status and device discovery

skills.description: The explicit acts that make output possible and end it: lovense_arm arms the master toggle (never a side effect of connecting or discovering), lovense_disarm zeroes active output synchronously and latches the master off, and lovense_stop is the always-available panic zero across every provider. A dropped session, a watchdog trip, and shutdown also zero output; recovery is always a fresh explicit arm.
skills.name: Safety gate: arm, disarm, stop

skills.description: Bounded, gate-clamped output on one device or every device: a single function at one strength (lovense_function), a pattern built from validated parts - feature letters, interval, at most 50 strengths (lovense_pattern) - or a built-in Lovense Remote app preset (lovense_preset). Strengths are clamped to the configured ceiling and the device's own range; durations are always bounded; results report the effective values actually sent.
skills.name: Gated output: function, pattern, preset

skills.description: ache_score_start atomically plans every part of a multi-device score through the decide() gate, then starts concurrent per-device streams; any refused part refuses the whole score. Stop with lovense_stop; heartbeat required while a score runs.
skills.name: Multi-device scores

skills.description: ache_pairing is the opt-in Server API provider's pairing surface: report whether the developer token and the paired user id are present in the password store (presence only, never a value), or request a QR code for the Owner to scan in Lovense Remote. Pairing completes in the app; a disabled provider refuses with provider_unavailable.
skills.name: Server API pairing

skills.description: ache_program_load validates, hashes, and stores frozen specs - ache.pattern/v1 (Square/Linear/Sine blocks or a bounded scripted expression), .funscript and the KoiSync six-axis ache.pack/v1, ache.depth/v1 depth curves, ache.automation/v1 (closed triggers and actions, jobs with required max_runs and max_span, frozen queues, typed clamped variables, a mandatory stop button), and ache.session/v1 compositions; ache_program_run runs one program with every command through the decide() gate (TCode axes at 50 Hz with per-axis windows and slew bounds); ache_program_event feeds named controls and pre-registered inputs, never values; ache_program_stop is the synchronous stop. Heartbeat required while a program runs.
skills.name: Program engine: patterns, automations, sessions
